The negative lookahead drops fui-FluentProvider and fui-FluentProvider_r_0_: the provider is never component anatomy, and `_r_0_` is a React useId counter — stable within a page (double-run probe: two full loads, byte-identical 366/366 class sets) but an implementation counter has no business in a part signature. varPrefix "--": Fluent's custom properties carry NO vendor prefix (RECON §2.4), so "--" is the tailwind/shadcn spelling; tokenGroup absent because the reader's var→leaf transform never emits a ".", so the DTCG tree is FLAT (459 leaves at top level, zero collisions measured across all 459).

mount.__note: THE WHOLE ROUND IS IN THIS WRAPPER. FluentProvider declares all 459 theme custom properties on a WRAPPER DIV, not on :root — RECON §2.3's probe measured `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)['--colorNeutralForeground1']` = '' (empty string) and the same on document.body, resolving to #242424 only on the `.fui-FluentProvider` div and on the `.fui-Button` inside it. Without the provider the page still RENDERS (Griffel's rules apply) and every var() silently falls back to the browser's initial values — the Carbon trap and the astryx @scope trap in one. The harness wraps the whole STAGE LIST (capture.ts:841, wrapperOpen sits outside SPECS.map), so one provider covers every combo, custom properties inherit, each stage's firstElementChild is still the component, and the value path never assumes :root (capture.ts:1238 reads getComputedStyle on the captured element). NO STYLESHEET IMPORT — Griffel ships no stylesheet at all and injects every rule at runtime; this is the first library in the corpus with an empty CSS story and an empty mount.imports beyond the provider.

__note:fonts: DELIBERATELY UNCONFIGURED — an unobtainable substrate, recorded rather than substituted. Fluent's font stack is `'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, …` and the library ships ZERO @font-face rules (measured: 0 across all 19 injected style elements — Griffel emits none and nothing else does either). Segoe UI is a Windows system font; it is not on npm and cannot be inlined as a data: URI. This is NOT Carbon's situation (Carbon's faces exist on npm and simply were not configured) — Fluent's faces do not exist to configure. Substituting a metric-compatible lookalike would re-pin every pixel reference to a face the library never names, so no `fonts` block is declared: text metrics are the harness's fallback metrics and pixel-AA reads low BY CONSTRUCTION. Read the computed-equality floor, not the pixel number.

__stopped-components.__stopped: STOPPED AT EMIT, 2026-08-08 — the contract is GOOD and the capture is green (8/8 combos, 97.015% computed equality, the round's second-best floor, byte-identical double run). What cannot be built is the CANVAS SCRIPT, and the cause is not in Fluent: MessageBar is the corpus's FIRST grid-rooted component (no other emitted script in all of examples/**/figma carries the grid placement sequencer at all, 116 checked), so that code path — which landed the same day in e16b6f6c — had never run on real output. Measured failure: `Cannot set grid child position: Can't place child at this position because it is occupied by another node`, and after a candidate fix, `grid-placement-cycle-no-spare: the declared 1x4 grid has no free cell to break a placement cycle through`. DIAGNOSIS, recorded so the next session starts where this one stopped: Fluent's MessageBar root is display:grid with four named areas (icon 0,0 · body 0,1 · secondaryActions 0,2 · actions 0,3); the emitted spec lists its children in exactly that order, so auto-flow already matches every target and ZERO moves should be needed. The sequencer nevertheless perceives a permutation cycle. A contributing defect was identified and is real: wrapInMarginBox inserts a wrapper frame into the parent and re-parents the built node into it, so for a part carrying a CSS margin (MessageBar's icon) the actual grid child is the WRAPPER while `built` still holds the inner node — both the occupancy read and the setGridChildPosition write then target a node the grid does not own. A fix resolving the grid child by ancestry was written and MOVED the failure from a hard canvas refusal to the named cycle refusal, but did not make the script build, so it was REVERTED rather than shipped unexercised: core/emit-figma-script.ts is byte-identical to e16b6f6c. Re-enabling this component needs no config change — only the grid placement path fixed by its owner.
